title: Nexus event
desc: A college-level event management platform developed for a hackathon. It allows institutions to publish event announcements, manage registrations, and share placement-related updates through a centralized web interface for students.

title: Login System with bcrypt
desc: A secure authentication system built using Node.js and Express. It uses bcrypt for password hashing and includes validation logic to protect user credentials and demonstrate backend authentication best practices .

title: Cat Facts Website
desc: A simple frontend application that fetches random cat facts from a public API. Built with JavaScript and styled using Tailwind CSS, it demonstrates API integration and dynamic data rendering in a clean UI.

title: Local Notes
desc: A React-based notes application that stores and retrieves user data using localStorage. It demonstrates handling form inputs, conditional rendering, and persistent client-side data without relying on a backend service.

title: HomeCare
desc: A real-world service booking application developed for a client. Users can request home services through EmailJS, and the project focuses on practical UI design, responsiveness, and delivering a functional solution.

title: Full Stack Blog App
desc: A full-stack blogging platform built with React, Node.js, and MySQL. It includes authentication, CRUD operations, image uploads, and a user dashboard, showcasing complete frontend and backend integration.
